content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I recently saw the new [product_name] at the [company_name] booth. Here are some details: It features 8 base modules (similar to [article_no] currently), 7 digital and 3 analog expansion modules, a redesigned look, a new display with 6 lines and 16/20 characters per line, and three background colors controlled by flags. All base modules now have a web server, allowing operational messages to be handled directly in a browser with simple enablement, message selection, and password entry—no need for HTML programming. It supports data logging to a MicroSD card with up to 20,000 records. The new [product_name] software ([product_name] V8) introduces drag-and-drop communication that simplifies setup compared to the previous Master/Slave approach. Automatic IP configuration is available on the PC. Pricing is expected to fall between the previous [product_name] versions. More details are published on the official internet page of [company_name]. [url] Enjoy!
Thanks for the update! I believe it means there's no need for HTML programming expertise.

Hello [user_name], As mentioned in the link: The new software features a redesigned look and familiar, simple single-mode operation, plus an all-new, extremely easy network mode configuration. Programming and feature setup are intuitive, allowing quick connections with a mouse click. Communication and display in the network view are configured automatically. Up to three programs can be viewed side-by-side, with drag-and-drop for easy signal transfer between programs, and smooth migration from previous versions.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are discussing the new capabilities of [product_name] and its latest software release. They show excitement for improved web-based functionality, advanced display features, and enhanced communications set up through drag-and-drop. Some users express dissatisfaction about the absence of a Profibus interface and ask about support for other modules like SIWAREX, indicating interest in broader integration. Overall, there is positive feedback about user-friendly web server configuration and reduced need for specialized programming knowledge, such as HTML.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simplified web access setup, better display options, easy communication configuration via drag-and-drop, and hope for support for various modules and interfaces, including Profibus and SIWAREX.
